bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs (TestWindow, UI testing kit only); springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs (model runner, no eval harness)
summary: Apple's Evaluations framework measures the quality of intelligence-powered features: datasets, evaluators, metrics, model-judge scoring, tool-call trajectory checks and Swift Testing integration. BifrOSt has no model-quality evaluation harness. Its testing kit covers UI and app tests, and the Assistant app runs a model with no scoring.

features.note: The Assistant runs the model but has no way to define a suite and run it against samples.
No dataset type, loader or synthetic sample generator exists in the repo.
No pass/fail or scored metric type; the calculator's springboard/apps/calculator-desktop/src/eval.rs is an expression parser, not an evaluation harness.
No typed result table for model responses.
No LLM-as-judge scoring anywhere in docs/ or tools/.
The bench script has an evaluation dict for VM boot checks (service active, home reached), not tool-call trajectories.
The SDK testing kit (TestWindow, click and state assertions) covers UI tests; it has no evaluation trait and no model scoring.

gaps: No model-quality evaluation harness: no suite definition, sample runner or scoring for the Assistant or any on-device model feature.
No datasets, loaders or synthetic sample generation for model tests.
No metric, evaluator or aggregation types, and no model-judge scoring.
No tool-call trajectory checks for agentic features.
No evaluation trait for the test kit; springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs covers UI tests only.
